evidence_notes: Rows are recorded GATE_RESULT suite timings, including subprocess overhead; they are not per-file timings.
Seconds are round(sum_seconds / entries, 3). These historical means are prediction only, not promises or evidence of a scheduling bottleneck.

Recorded zero-second means are retained as 0.0. Mixed zero/positive selected weights use LPT; entirely zero selected weights or missing/invalid timing data force equal-count fallback for the entire selected union.
Entry counts include all recorded rows, including zero-second suites. No raw logs are retained in this snapshot.
